execution.afterRerunChanges: Evidence test/config formatting only; retained exact tested bytes and AST kind/leaf-text equality proof. No repeated test execution during final review.

covered: Unknown status alone remains unresolved and cannot dispatch a successor.
Only explicit cancellation after unknownRequest and exact agentId/requestId/cancelRequested=true/null acknowledgement retires tracking.

Automatic close/retire cancellation cannot grant this recovery to a replacement owner.
Wrong Agent, wrong request and false cancelRequested acknowledgements remain blocked.

The original fixed 300-second selection ticket predates that new 300-second tombstone and cannot authorize a new dispatch after it expires. These premises do not establish a historical command outcome.
